# Release Notes — Documentation Excellence v4.5 UX6

## Document Library

Documentation Excellence now provides a local metadata-based knowledge
workspace for previous documentation. Consultants can search meaningful
content, combine discovery filters, sort or group by document profile, mark
favourites and reopen recently used work. Cards and Quick Preview show concise
identity, activity and qualitative health without loading the project.

Document Library stores metadata only. Review loading remains on demand.
Semantic Document remains unchanged. Documentation Intelligence remains
advisory. Celebrate Progress remains integrated. Word export behaviour remains
unchanged.

The release does not add cloud synchronization, collaboration, sharing,
version control, AI search or full-document preview.
